info.title: Cart & Rewards API
info.description:
Carts, idempotent checkout, orders, and a coupon made available after every n-th placed order.

## Conventions

- **Money** is always a decimal string with two digits, such as `"19.99"`, never a JSON number.
- **Errors** always have one shape: `{ "status": "error", "code": "...", "message": "...", "details": {...}? }`.
  Branch on `code`, not on `message`. All codes are listed below.
- **Administrative operations** live under `/api/admin`. Authentication is not implemented.

## A typical purchase

1. `GET /api/products`, then `POST /api/carts`.
2. `POST /api/carts/{id}/items` for each product (repeat adds increase the quantity).
3. `POST /api/carts/{id}/checkout`. A cart is single-use: create a new one for the next purchase.
4. `GET /api/orders/{id}` returns the order exactly as placed.

## Retrying checkout

The cart is the idempotency key. If a checkout request times out or its response is lost, send the same
request again: the original order is returned with `200` and header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`, and no second
order or stock deduction happens. A failed checkout (stock, price, coupon or payment) changes nothing.

## Prices and stock

Adding to a cart does not reserve stock. Checkout is the authority: it re-checks stock and prices in one
transaction. If a price changed since the item was added, checkout returns `409 PRICE_CHANGED` with the old and
new prices; retry with `acceptPriceChanges: true` to be charged the current prices.

## Coupons

Every n-th successfully placed order reaches a milestone (n is configured). An administrator calls
`POST /api/admin/coupons/generate` to create the coupon for the lowest unrewarded milestone. A coupon takes a
percentage off the whole order subtotal (rounded half up, never below zero), is single-use, and is consumed only
if the checkout succeeds.

## Error codes

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | A field is missing, malformed or out of range. `details.errors` lists each field. | Fix the request. Retrying unchanged will fail again. |
| `INVALID_BODY` | 400 | The request body is not valid JSON. | Send well-formed JSON. |
| `PAYMENT_DECLINED` | 402 | The payment was declined. Nothing was changed: stock and coupon are untouched. | Retry with another payment method; the cart is still open. |
| `PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | The product does not exist. | Use an id from `GET /api/products`. |
| `CART_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | The cart does not exist. | Create one with `POST /api/carts`. |
| `ITEM_NOT_IN_CART` | 404 | That product is not in the cart. | Add it first, or refresh the cart view. |
| `ORDER_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | The order does not exist. | Check the order id returned by checkout. |
| `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | No such endpoint. | Check the path and method. |
| `INSUFFICIENT_STOCK` | 409 | Not enough stock. `details.lines` lists each short product with `requested` and `available`. Nothing was changed. | Lower the quantities or remove the items, then retry. |
| `PRICE_CHANGED` | 409 | A price changed since the item was added. `details.lines` lists `oldUnitPrice` and `newUnitPrice`. Nothing was changed. | Show the new prices; to accept them, retry checkout with `acceptPriceChanges: true`. |
| `CART_NOT_OPEN` | 409 | The cart was already checked out and can no longer be changed. | Create a new cart for the next purchase. |
| `CART_ALREADY_CHECKED_OUT` | 409 | The cart was checked out with a different coupon than this request. `details.orderId` is the original order. | Fetch the original order; do not retry with a different body. |
| `COUPON_ALREADY_REDEEMED` | 409 | The coupon has already been used. Nothing was changed. | Retry without the coupon, or with a different one. |
| `NO_ELIGIBLE_MILESTONE` | 409 | No unrewarded order milestone has been reached. `details` shows orders placed and orders until the next milestone. | Try again after more orders are placed. |
| `CART_EMPTY` | 422 | The cart has no items. | Add at least one item before checkout. |
| `COUPON_NOT_FOUND` | 422 | The coupon code does not exist. Nothing was changed. | Check the code, or retry without a coupon. |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Unexpected server error. Details are logged, not returned. | Retry; checkout is safe to retry. |
| `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | 503 | The database is temporarily unreachable. | Retry shortly; checkout is safe to retry. |

post.description:
Validates the cart and places the order in one transaction: re-checks prices and stock, takes the stock, charges payment, stores the order and closes the cart.

**Safe to retry.** The cart is the idempotency key: a repeated request for a cart that was already checked out returns the original order with `200` and header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. No second order and no second stock deduction.

An optional `couponCode` takes its percentage off the whole subtotal (rounded half up, never below zero). A coupon is single-use and is only consumed if the checkout succeeds. Retrying with the same body replays; retrying a checked-out cart with a different coupon returns `409 CART_ALREADY_CHECKED_OUT`.

Success: `201` with the new order. Errors: `404 CART_NOT_FOUND`, `422 CART_EMPTY`, `422 COUPON_NOT_FOUND`, `409 COUPON_ALREADY_REDEEMED`, `409 PRICE_CHANGED` (details list old/new price per line; retry with `acceptPriceChanges: true`), `409 INSUFFICIENT_STOCK` (details list every short line), `402 PAYMENT_DECLINED`. A failed checkout changes nothing: stock and the cart are untouched.

post.description: Every n-th successfully placed order reaches a milestone. This creates one coupon for the lowest milestone that has been reached and not yet rewarded. Call it again for the next one. Safe under concurrency: simultaneous calls never create two coupons for one milestone.\n\nErrors: `409 NO_ELIGIBLE_MILESTONE` (details show orders placed and orders until the next milestone).

Computed from one consistent snapshot, read-only, and identical for repeated calls while no orders change. Reconciles with `GET /admin/orders` and `GET /admin/coupons`.
